faq.title: Got Questions?
faq.subtitle: Learn how RemitBuddy helps you save.
faq.q1_desc: Yes! RemitBuddy is 100% free. We never charge you for comparing rates. Our goal is to help you find the best deal at no extra cost.
faq.q2_desc: We show you live rates at the moment you click 'Compare for Free'. Keep in mind that rates can change frequently.
faq.q3_title: Can I send money through RemitBuddy?
faq.q3_desc: RemitBuddy is a comparison platform. Once you find the best deal, we'll direct you to the provider's official site to complete your transfer.
faq.q4_desc: We compare Hanpass, Sentbe, GME, E9Pay, Cross, and other licensed remittance providers in Korea.
faq.q5_title: Why do rates differ between providers?
faq.q5_desc: Each provider has different networks, partnerships, and fee structures. Some offer better rates for large amounts; others are cheaper for smaller transfers. That's why comparing matters!

education.title: Money Transfer Tips
education.subtitle: Smart tips for better transfers
education.tip1_desc: A great exchange rate can be offset by high fees. Always compare the final amount received.
education.tip2_desc: Rates fluctuate throughout the day. Major news or market openings can cause swings.
education.tip3_desc: Faster transfers often cost more. Waiting 1-2 days might get you a better rate.
education.tip4_desc: Some providers add receiving bank fees or conversion charges. RemitBuddy shows the true total.
